cohorts: 471 meta-fit users select;472 development users evaluate; explicit-liked metrics include only users with held-out likes. Repeated random splits share users and are not independent populations.
control_distinction: Random-pool control changes disliked item identities/reuse. Exact permutation control preserves each user liked anchors and disliked counterpart multiset, changing only pair alignment.
interpretation: Matched liked-disliked pairs are operational contrasts, not proven exceptions or emotions. Missing ratings are unknown; known dislike rate is a lower bound over recommendation slots. Novelty unestablished.
selection: Each model and each relevance definition selects settings using only meta-fit labels. Fixed grids neighbors20/80,negative vote0/1,ridge50/250/1000,pair gate temperature.1/.5.
stages: Revision2 and control corrections respond to development results. Tests are frozen separately and must not select models.
status: development evidence only; final test unopened when curated
training: Train-only ratings>=4 likes,<=2 dislikes,3 neutral; all training observations masked. Item geometry signed SVD32 + genres. RBF gamma1, random Fourier128 for relation-neighbor model.
